name: Elite Portable Smoothie Blender & Grinder, 380W, 600ML Capacity
description:
POWERFUL 380W MOTOR & GRINDING PERFORMANCE – Blend smoothies, juices, protein shakes, and frozen drinks with a high-performance 380W motor, 6 stainless steel blades, and a powerful 6000mAh rechargeable battery. The IPX7 waterproof design makes cleaning quick and easy.
2-IN-1 BLENDER & GRINDER WITH DUAL MODES – Enjoy the versatility of blending fresh juices or grinding nuts by changing the blade cover. Choose between Automatic Mode for everyday blending and Pulse Mode for tougher ingredients and improved ice crushing.
PREMIUM BPA-FREE TRITAN CUP – The 600ml cup is made from food-grade Tritan material that is BPA-free, heat-resistant, durable, and impact-resistant, providing a safe and reliable blending experience for daily use.
DUAL BLENDING MODES – Press A for Normal Mode to blend fruits, vegetables, smoothies, and other soft ingredients. Press B for Pulse Mode to crush ice and process nuts, coffee beans, spices, and other tougher ingredients for maximum versatility.
SAFE, PORTABLE & USER-FRIENDLY DESIGN – Features a magnetic safety lock that only operates when the cup is securely attached, a protective blade cover for safer handling, a convenient carry handle, and a portable drinking lid so you can blend, carry, and enjoy your drink anywhere.
USB-C RECHARGEABLE & COMPLETE ACCESSORY SET – Recharge easily with the built-in USB Type-C port. Includes a 650ml blending cup, charging cable, cleaning brush, blade cover, bottom drinking lid, and user manual—ideal for home, office, gym, travel, and outdoor adventures.
IPX7 WATERPROOF & EASY TO CLEAN – The IPX7 waterproof design allows for quick and convenient cleaning after every use. Simply add water, run a blending cycle for easy self-cleaning, then rinse thoroughly. For safe cleaning, always ensure the USB-C charging port cover is securely closed before washing.
RELIABLE CUSTOMER SUPPORT: FATHOM is committed to your satisfaction with dedicated support for product setup, usage guidance, and troubleshooting assistance, helping you get the best performance from your product.

name: Elite Manual Coffee Grinder
description:
35 Adjustable Grind Settings: Choose your preferred coffee texture with 35 grind settings, ranging from fine to coarse. Adjust the grind according to your brewing method, whether you prefer espresso, pour-over, French press or cold brew.
Ceramic Burr for Consistent Grinding: The ceramic burr mechanism is designed to grind coffee beans evenly and consistently, helping you prepare freshly ground coffee while preserving the natural aroma and flavor of the beans.
30g Bean Capacity & Compact Design: With a 30g bean capacity and dimensions of 14 × 13 × 7 cm, the grinder is convenient for everyday use and easy to store or carry, making it suitable for home, office or travel.
Transparent Glass Collection Jar: The glass jar allows you to clearly see the freshly ground coffee and makes it convenient to collect the grounds after grinding. The transparent design adds a clean and practical touch to the grinder.
Manual Grinding Without Electricity: Enjoy freshly ground coffee without depending on electricity or batteries. Simply add your coffee beans, select the desired grind setting and manually grind the beans according to your preference.
Suitable for Multiple Brewing Methods: From fine espresso grounds to coarser grounds for French press and cold brew, the adjustable grinding mechanism lets you prepare coffee grounds for different brewing styles in one convenient grinder.
